title: EGCG as a therapeutic agent: a systematic review of recent advances and challenges in nanocarrier strategies | Journal of Zhejiang University-SCIENCE B | Springer Nature Link
abstract: June 30, 2025 - Despite its immense promise, the practical utilization of EGCG in therapeutic settings as a medication has been hampered by inherent limitations of this drug, including poor bioavailability, instability, and rapid degradation .
